prompt.project_info: Create an elegant natural indoor portrait of an approved adult woman seated in a cream armchair wearing a champagne silk slip dress.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with shoulder-length strawberry-blonde beachy waves, no-makeup makeup, mauve-pink lips, soft mascara and brown eyeshadow, and a thoughtful sideward gaze. She wears a knee-length champagne silk-satin slip dress with cowl neckline and thin straps, a delicate silver pendant chain, and drop earrings. Show three natural poses: seated with a gentle smile, standing beside the chair, and seated looking aside thoughtfully.
prompt.composition_elements: Cream textured armchair, vertical pleated cream/beige curtains, dark window, medium portrait and full-length variants, realistic silk sheen, understated jewelry, and clean luxury-room or studio setting.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft natural indoor light with gentle highlights on satin and skin, calm graceful atmosphere, beige/champagne/nude palette.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 4K portrait, natural lens perspective, sharp face and silk texture, realistic hands, medium depth, subtle grain, consistent identity across poses.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an elegant photorealistic indoor portrait series of an approved adult woman with shoulder-length strawberry-blonde beachy waves, no-makeup makeup, mauve-pink lips, soft mascara, brown eyeshadow, and natural skin texture. She wears a knee-length champagne silk-satin slip dress with a cowl neckline and thin straps, delicate silver pendant chain, and drop earrings. Create three consistent natural poses: seated in a cream textured armchair with a gentle smile, standing beside the chair with one hand on it, and seated looking aside with a thoughtful expression. Use vertical pleated cream curtains, a dark window, soft natural indoor light, gentle satin and skin highlights, beige/champagne/nude palette, realistic hands and fabric, sharp facial detail, and subtle grain.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized framing, erotic pose, minor or child, age ambiguity, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face, inconsistent identity, text, logo
